post.description:
Create a new dataset with one of three storage types:
- **managed**: System creates and manages a new EOS bucket
- **existing_bucket**: Connect to an existing EOS bucket with provided credentials
- **pvc**: Create a dataset with disk storage 

Optionally supports encryption (SSE-KMS or SSE-C) for managed and existing_bucket types.

parameters.name: active_iam
parameters.description: Active IAM ID **(To access contact person account)** [**Find your Active IAM ID here**](/paths/users-iam-accounts/get)

storage_type.description: Type of storage for the dataset

pvc.description: PVC configuration, required if storage_type is pvc

disk_size.description: Disk size for the PVC in GB

bucket.description: Bucket configuration, required if storage_type is existing_bucket

endpoint.description: Endpoint URL of the object store

access_key.description: Access key configuration, required if storage_type is existing_bucket

encryption_type.description:
Type of encryption to use (required if encryption_enable is true):
- sse-kms: Server-side encryption with KMS (E2E managed)
- sse-c: Server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (user managed)

201.description: Success response indicating that the dataset was created.

get.description:
Retrieve lifecycle rules configured for the dataset's EOS bucket.
Only applicable for datasets with storage_type 'managed' or 'existing_bucket'.

parameters.name: active_iam
parameters.description: Active IAM ID **(To access contact person account)** [**Find your Active IAM ID here**](/paths/users-iam-accounts/get)

200.description: Success response with lifecycle rule list.

post.description:
Create a lifecycle rule for automatic object expiration in the dataset's EOS bucket.
Rules can be applied to all objects or to objects with a specific prefix.

parameters.name: active_iam
parameters.description: Active IAM ID **(To access contact person account)** [**Find your Active IAM ID here**](/paths/users-iam-accounts/get)

apply_to.description:
Scope of the lifecycle rule:
- all_objects: Apply rule to all objects in the bucket
- objects_with_prefix: Apply rule only to objects with the specified prefix

expiration_days.description: Number of days after which objects will be deleted

prefix.description: Object prefix/folder path (required when apply_to is objects_with_prefix)

200.description: Success response with lifecycle rules information.

id.description: Unique identifier of the lifecycle rule.

deleted.description: Indicates whether the rule is deleted.

enabled.description: Whether the lifecycle rule is enabled.

prefix.description: Object prefix the rule applies to.

expiry_date_or_days.description: Expiry date or number of days.

user.description: User ID who created the rule.

delete.description: Delete a lifecycle rule from the dataset's EOS bucket.

parameters.name: active_iam
parameters.description: Active IAM ID **(To access contact person account)** [**Find your Active IAM ID here**](/paths/users-iam-accounts/get)

parameters.name: rule_id
parameters.description: ID of the lifecycle rule to delete

200.description: Success response for lifecycle rule deletion.
